searchText: Oooh I would love to I guess one reason I was being quiet on that is that I don't want to throw even more extra work on the devs when 4844 is ballooning into a megaproject that includes a halfway-transition to SSZ But obviously since I was acting on behalf of devs, I am absolutely happy to be overruled by devs 😊 btw this should be EVM-global, right? Not EOF-specific As if it's EOF-specific, then the gains in protocol simplification and adding invariants don't really come to pass
